Survival of a TCGA/GDC project's patients (Kaplan-Meier; eligible two-group log-rank, Cox HR for...

gf_tcga_survival.Rd

Survival of a TCGA/GDC project's patients (Kaplan-Meier; eligible two-group log-rank, Cox HR for expression splits), with its figure. With neither stratify nor gene it is the whole-cohort (overall) curve every survival screen opens on. stratify=expression (implied by a gene with no stratify) splits patients at the median of one gene with the Survival tab's analysis (OS from GDC clinical follow-up); split_on=methylation splits on that gene's methylation instead, and split_on=cnv on its copy number, with the same analysis (both OS only, TCGA only); DSS, PFI and DFI are the Survival tab's PanCanAtlas endpoints (TCGA only). stratify=none is the Survival tab's whole-cohort curve for any outcome (no gene). Clinical stratify uses GDC case fields; mutation splits non-silent mutation status for gene. split_scheme=tertiles|quartiles with split_comparison=extremes|all uses the Survival tab, with shared cut points, exclusions, omnibus/trend tests and ordered hues (expression and methylation; CNV stays median-only by design). Clinical/mutation splits use the Survival tab's analysis for every endpoint (the app's PNG). csv / recipe write the screen's export. Latency: 5-30 s cold. Figures: the Survival tab's median, whole-cohort, categorical and quantile curves are the app's PNG exports, and a median CNV or methylation split is the Expression screen's survival report PNG; a methylation quantile figure is drawn by the same engine but has no app screen.

Usage

gf_tcga_survival(
    session,
    `project`,
    `csv` = NULL,
    `dpi` = NULL,
    `figure` = NULL,
    `format` = NULL,
    `gene` = NULL,
    `height_in` = NULL,
    `html` = NULL,
    `inline_image` = NULL,
    `outcome` = NULL,
    `outline_text` = NULL,
    `output_name` = NULL,
    `recipe` = NULL,
    `scrub_at_years` = NULL,
    `show_caption_color_keys` = NULL,
    `show_figure_legends` = NULL,
    `show_row_counts` = NULL,
    `size` = NULL,
    `split_comparison` = NULL,
    `split_on` = NULL,
    `split_scheme` = NULL,
    `stratify` = NULL,
    `stratify_derived` = NULL,
    `survival_detail` = NULL,
    `survival_median_lines` = NULL,
    `width_in` = NULL,
    progress_callback = NULL
)

Arguments

session

A GeneFox session from gf_session.

project

(string; one of "TCGA-ACC", "TCGA-BLCA", "TCGA-BRCA", "TCGA-CESC", "TCGA-CHOL", "TCGA-COAD", "TCGA-DLBC", "TCGA-ESCA", "TCGA-GBM", "TCGA-HNSC", "TCGA-KICH", "TCGA-KIRC", "TCGA-KIRP", "TCGA-LAML", "TCGA-LGG", "TCGA-LIHC", "TCGA-LUAD", "TCGA-LUSC", "TCGA-MESO", "TCGA-OV", "TCGA-PAAD", "TCGA-PCPG", "TCGA-PRAD", "TCGA-READ", "TCGA-SARC", "TCGA-SKCM", "TCGA-STAD", "TCGA-TGCT", "TCGA-THCA", "TCGA-THYM", "TCGA-UCEC", "TCGA-UCS", "TCGA-UVM", "TARGET-ALL-P1", "TARGET-ALL-P2", "TARGET-ALL-P3", "TARGET-AML", "TARGET-CCSK", "TARGET-NBL", "TARGET-OS", "TARGET-RT", "TARGET-WT", "APOLLO-LUAD", "BEATAML1.0-COHORT", "CDDP_EAGLE-1", "CGCI-BLGSP", "CGCI-HTMCP-CC", "CGCI-HTMCP-DLBCL", "CGCI-HTMCP-LC", "CMI-ASC", "CMI-MBC", "CMI-MPC", "CPTAC-2", "CPTAC-3", "CTSP-DLBCL1", "EXCEPTIONAL_RESPONDERS-ER", "HCMI-CMDC", "MMRF-COMMPASS", "MP2PRT-ALL", "MP2PRT-WT", "NCICCR-DLBCL", "OHSU-CNL", "ORGANOID-PANCREATIC", "REBC-THYR", "WCDT-MCRPC") TCGA/TARGET project id, e.g. TCGA-KIRC.

csv

(boolean, optional; default false) Also write the screen's CSV export (the app's own rows) under the output directory and return csv.path. NULL omits it.

dpi

(integer, optional; default 300; range 72..1200) Resolution of a custom size (at most 8,192 px a side and 16 MP). NULL omits it.

figure

(boolean, optional; default true) Draw the figure and return its PNG path. NULL omits it.

format

(string, optional; one of "png", "svg", "tiff"; default "png") Figure format: png (raster, default), svg (vector with editable text), or tiff (raster, .tif); one per run. NULL omits it.

gene

(string, optional) HGNC gene symbol, required for expression or mutation survival and forbidden for clinical or none. Upper-cased. NULL omits it.

height_in

(number, optional; range 1..40) Custom figure height in inches (with the other side; instead of size). The app's size control range. NULL omits it.

html

(boolean, optional; default false) Write the screen's single-figure HTML export under the output directory and return html.path. Requires figure. NULL omits it.

inline_image

(boolean, optional; default false) Include PNG MCP image content up to 1,048,576 bytes; larger files stay on disk and disclose inline_image_omitted. NULL omits it.

outcome

(string, optional; one of "OS", "DSS", "PFI", "DFI"; default "OS") OS (overall survival, GDC clinical; default), or PanCanAtlas DSS (disease-specific), PFI (progression-free interval), DFI (disease-free interval). DSS/PFI/DFI require TCGA. NULL omits it.

outline_text

(boolean, optional; default false) With format svg, write labels as glyph outlines instead of editable text. Refused with other formats. NULL omits it.

output_name

(string, optional) Optional figure name replacing tool and title slug: up to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'; starts alphanumeric, no '..'. Session number, size and extension remain; collisions get -2, -3, etc. NULL omits it.

recipe

(boolean, optional; default false) Write an app recipe that reopens this analysis and return recipe.path. NULL omits it.

scrub_at_years

(array, optional) Read the Kaplan-Meier figure at these times (years, each finite and at least 0; at most 20), as the app's hover card does: each time snaps to the nearest curve point and returns, per arm, survival and the number at risk AT the snapped time, plus the card's text. Answered in data.scrub, in request order. NULL omits it.

show_caption_color_keys

(boolean, optional; default true) Figure style: a table caption carries the sentence explaining the figure's colors. NULL omits it.

show_figure_legends

(boolean, optional; default true) Figure style: the figure draws its own legend. NULL omits it.

show_row_counts

(boolean, optional; default true) Figure style: a box plot's row labels carry each group's n. NULL omits it.

size

(string, optional; one of "single_column", "one_and_a_half_column", "double_column", "slide", "poster"; default "double_column") Figure size preset (the app's export presets); double_column is the app default. NULL omits it.

split_comparison

(string, optional; one of "extremes", "all"; default "extremes") Tertiles/quartiles: extremes compares top vs bottom and counts excluded middle patients; all draws every group with omnibus and trend log-rank tests. Median requires extremes. NULL omits it.

split_on

(string, optional; one of "expression", "cnv", "methylation"; default "expression") For stratify=expression: expression (default), cnv (gene-level GISTIC2), or methylation (mean HM450 beta). cnv and methylation require OS and TCGA. NULL omits it.

split_scheme

(string, optional; one of "median", "tertiles", "quartiles"; default "median") Expression and methylation: median (default), tertiles, or quartiles. CNV is median only. NULL omits it.

stratify

(string, optional; one of "expression", "none", "mutation", "sex_at_birth", "stage", "race", "ethnicity", "age_group", "diagnosis", "disease_type", "grade"; default "none") none: whole cohort (default without gene); expression: gene median split (default with gene); mutation: Mutant vs WT. Clinical factors use case fields without gene. Vital status, sample type and molecular subtype forbidden. NULL omits it.

stratify_derived

(object, optional) Group by a derived variable instead of a stratify factor (GeneFox's derived-variable recipe). sourceColumn is age_at_index with a numeric_threshold rule (bins the age itself), or a case-level factor token (gender, vital_status, stage, race, ethnicity, age_group, diagnosis, disease_type, grade) with a category_merge rule over that factor's labels. One factor only: no stratify, stratify_secondary or keep_groups beside it, and no saved recipe or link. NULL omits it.

survival_detail

(string, optional; one of "none", "inference", "inferenceAndEffect", "full"; default "inferenceAndEffect") Figure style: how much of a Kaplan-Meier findings block to draw (the app's Figure Style setting). NULL omits it.

survival_median_lines

(boolean, optional; default false) Figure style: draw dashed median survival guides for reached medians. NULL omits it.

width_in

(number, optional; range 1..40) Custom figure width in inches (with the other side; instead of size). The app's size control range. NULL omits it.

progress_callback

Optional function receiving runtime progress events; NULL disables progress.

Value

A gf_result holding the engine payload, provenance and owned figures for the tcga_survival tool. The runtime validates every argument and refuses tools absent from its gf_tools() list. Result contract: https://genefox.app/schemas/v1/tcga-survival-result-v1.schema.json.
